specification.title: An already-investigated IP is not pivoted again
specification.description: An IP already investigated at the same depth is not pivoted again.
specification.purpose: Verify the coordinator does not re-pivot an entity already investigated at the same depth.
specification.operational_relevance: Re-analysing identical identities wastes provider budget and creates confusing duplicate work in long investigations.
specification.regression_risk: The coordinator could re-pivot the IP despite the existing investigation mark.

required: The root-domain DNS provider work executes
forbidden: The already-investigated IP appears as a pivot execution
